verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a first-party SOC 2 workflow. It says it streamlines SOC 2 'at every step' toward audit readiness, condenses 200+ controls into steps, maps controls to framework requirements, provides auditor-approved policy templates and automates evidence collection through integrations. The evidence never distinguishes Type I from Type II audits, never names the Trust Services Criteria, and never describes auditor evidence requests inside the platform. That leaves the end-to-end, dual-audit-type part of the story unproven. Missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II support, Trust Services Criteria control mapping, an evidence-request workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: Secureframe automates and streamlines the SOC 2 process at every step so you can get audit ready quickly and easily.
Secureframe simplifies SOC 2 audits by condensing 200+ controls into 8 key steps.
Each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
Save time writing policies from scratch with Secureframe's policy templates. Each template is written and approved by former auditors
Automate manual evidence collection utilizing our 100+ integrations
